campus_notes: Dimensions compiled 2026-08-12 from a research document cross-referenced with UMass Amherst housing floor plans and student-sourced specs. UMass Amherst does not publish an official per-room ft x ft table; where the source gave a range or only square footage, a representative ft x ft was used (data_confidence: medium). Multi-room suites and apartments are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Undergraduate beds are Twin XL. Standard blueprints broken down by residential area and room type. Traditional halls feature painted concrete block walls and standard movable furniture. On 2026-11-14 the four group entries (traditional halls, Sylvan, Commonwealth Honors College, North Apartments) were split into the 47 residence halls listed by UMass Residential Life (residence directory at https://www.umass.edu/living/housing-options/residence-directory) plus North Apartments, kept as one complex of buildings A-D; each hall carries its style's typical room sizes and only the room types UMass lists for it, and air conditioning is set only where the hall page says so.
